blocks.text: Woh kemiyai (chemical) madda jo enzyme ki sargarmi mein rukawat dale aur use roke inhibitor hai. Inhibitors enzymes se jurte hain magar products mein nahin badalte, aur yun active sites ko aarzi (temporary) ya mustaqil (permanent) taur par rok dete hain. Yeh amal enzyme inhibition hai. Pecheeda (complex) enzymatic reactions ke aakhri products bhi pehle qadam ke enzyme ke inhibitors ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Inhibitors bataur dawa aur zehar
blocks.text: Inhibitors aksar dawaon ke taur par istemal hote hain, magar yeh zehar (poison) ka kaam bhi kar sakte hain. Aspirin dawa ke taur par istemal hone wala enzyme inhibitor hai: yeh un enzymes ko rokti hai jo prostaglandin banate hain, jo sozish (inflammation) ka sabab hai, is liye aspirin dard aur sozish dabati hai. Zehar cyanide ek irreversible enzyme inhibitor hai jo cytochrome oxidase ke active site ke copper aur lohe (iron) se mil kar cellular respiration rok deta hai.

Inhibitor ki do aam classes tasleem ki jati hain. Competitive inhibitor enzyme ke substrate jaisa hota hai aur enzyme par ek hi binding site ke liye us se muqabla karta hai. Jab binding site competitive inhibitor ko chun leta hai to woh active site rok deta hai aur substrate ko jurne nahin deta, is liye enzyme kaam nahin kar pata. Maslan enzyme succinic dehydrogenase succinic acid ka fumaric acid mein oxidation catalyse karta hai; malonic acid banawat mein succinic acid jaisa hai, is liye dono active site ke liye muqabla karte hain, aur jab malonic acid chun liya jaye to woh site rok deta hai.

blocks.alt: Do marhale. Gurde (kidney) jaisa enzyme jis ka active site V jaisa hai; substrate aur milti-julti shakal ka inhibitor dono us ki taraf barhte hain (Competition between substrate and inhibitor). Phir inhibitor active site mein beth jata hai aur substrate bahar reh jata hai (Inhibitor attaches with active site and blocks it); nuqtedar teer No products tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Inhibitor, Active site, Enzyme.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.9: Enzyme ki competitive inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Inhibitor ki shakal substrate jaisi hai, is liye dono ek hi active site ke liye muqabla (competition) karte hain. Jab inhibitor site mein beth jata hai to substrate jur nahin sakta aur products nahin bante. Misal: succinic dehydrogenase ke active site par malonic acid, succinic acid se muqabla karta hai.

blocks.title: Competitive inhibitors bataur antibiotics
blocks.text: Competitive inhibitors bacteria maarne ke liye antibiotics ke taur par istemal hote hain. Yeh inhibitor molecules bacteria ke un enzymes ke substrates jaisi banawat rakhte hain jo bacteria ki zindagi ke liye zaroori hain; inhibitors jur kar un enzymes ko rok dete hain.

Non-competitive inhibitor ki substrate se koi asal banawati mushabahat nahin hoti, is liye yeh active site mein dakhil nahin hota. Is ki bajaye yeh enzyme se doosri jagahon par jurta hai, aur is ka jurna enzyme ki shakal badal deta hai jis se active site substrate se nahin milta aur enzyme ruk jata hai. Maslan do substrates succinic acid aur CoA mil kar succinyl-CoA banate hain, jo succinyl-CoA synthetase catalyse karta hai; banne ke baad paidawar succinyl-CoA non-competitive inhibitor ka kaam karti hai aur enzyme se jurti hai, to enzyme ruk jata hai aur mazeed succinyl-CoA nahin banta.

blocks.alt: Teer se jure teen marhale. Gol enzyme jis ka active site cone jaise substrate ke mutabiq tikona (wedge) hai, aur neeche baen taraf ek doosri chhoti jeb (pocket); paas ek peela inhibitor. Inhibitor us jeb se jurta hai (Enzyme-inhibitor complex). Phir active site ek tang seedhi darar ban jata hai jo substrate se nahin milta (Shape of active site altered); nuqtedar teer No products tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, Inhibitor.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.10: Enzyme ki non-competitive inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan inhibitor substrate jaisa nahin aur active site mein dakhil nahin hota; woh enzyme ki doosri jagah jurta hai. Is ke jurne se enzyme ki shakal badalti hai: active site ka tikona shigaf seedhi tang darar ban jata hai, substrate fit nahin hota aur products nahin bante.

Inhibitor ka amal irreversible ya reversible ho sakta hai, is par munhasir ke woh enzyme ke saath kis qisam ka bond banata hai. Irreversible inhibitors enzyme ke saath covalent bonds banate hain; unhen dilution, dialysis ya substrate ki concentration barha kar nahin hataya ja sakta. Maslan penicillin bacteria ki cell walls banane wale enzyme ko mustaqil na-kara kar deti hai. Reversible inhibitors enzyme ke saath kamzor bonds, jaise hydrogen bonds, banate hain; unhen hataya ja sakta hai, aur un ki inhibition substrate ki concentration barha kar khatam ki ja sakti hai. Malonate reversible inhibitor hai: yeh succinate dehydrogenase, jo cellular respiration mein shamil hai, ko rok kar reaction aarzi taur par sust karta hai, aur malonate hatane par inhibition ulat jati hai.

items: Enzyme inhibition metabolic raston ko qaboo karne mein nihayat aham kirdar ada karti hai: khaas enzymes ko rok kar kisi metabolic reaction ki raftar qaboo ki ja sakti hai.
Bohat si dawaein inhibitors ke taur par kaam karti hain. Antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes rokti hain, jabke cancer ki dawaein cell division mein shamil enzymes rok sakti hain.
Enzyme inhibitors mukhtalif tibbi halaton ke intezam mein istemal hote hain; maslan khoon jamne ke enzymes ke kuch inhibitors anticoagulants ke taur par istemal hote hain.
Kuch toxins aur zehar jism ke aham enzymes rokte hain; yeh samajhna ke yeh inhibitors enzymes par kaise asar dalte hain zehar-khurani ke ilaj mein nihayat aham ho sakta hai.

Enzyme inhibitors dawa sazi ki research mein qeemti aale hain, jo khaas enzymes ke kaam aur mumkina dawaon ke mutale mein istemal hote hain. Inhibition enzyme kinetics aur enzyme ki sargarmi par asar dalne wale awamil ke mutale ka bhi aham hissa hai.

blocks.text: Metabolic raston mein ek reaction ki paidawar agle ki substrate banti hai, aur raste ke aakhir mein ek matloob paidawar banti hai. Us paidawar ki concentration qaboo karne ke liye raste ko band karna parta hai, aur yeh feedback inhibition se hota hai: raste ki aakhri paidawar inhibitor ka kaam karti hai, kisi shuruati enzyme se mil kar us ki conformation badal deti hai jis se enzyme apne substrate se nahin jur pata. Rasta band ho jata hai aur mazeed paidawar nahin banti. Maslan jab cell ke paas zaroorat se zyada ATP ho to ATP khud non-competitive inhibitor ka kaam karta hai aur ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.

blocks.title: Feedback inhibition
blocks.text: Woh amal jis mein kisi amal ki paidawar us amal ko khud qaboo karti hai, aam taur par mazeed paidawar ki tayyari mehdood kar ke.

blocks.alt: Neeche ek raasta (pathway): substrate enzyme 1 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate A banata hai; A enzyme 2 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate B banata hai; B enzyme 3 mein jata hai jo end product (hara chokor) banata hai. Feedback ka teer end product se wapas enzyme 1 tak jata hai, jo upar dikhaya gaya hai: end product us ke pehlu se jura hai aur substrate bahar hai (Enzyme inhibited); nuqtedar teer No more product tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.11: Enzyme ke kaam ki feedback inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Neeche ek raasta (pathway): substrate enzyme 1 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate A banata hai; A enzyme 2 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate B banata hai; B enzyme 3 mein jata hai jo end product (hara chokor) banata hai. Feedback ka teer end product se wapas enzyme 1 tak jata hai, jo upar dikhaya gaya hai: end product us ke pehlu se jura hai aur substrate bahar hai (Enzyme inhibited); nuqtedar teer No more product tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Enzyme 1, Enzyme 2, Enzyme 3, Intermediate Substrate A, Intermediate Substrate B, End product, Feedback, Enzyme inhibited, No more product.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche baen se daen chalein: har enzyme ki paidawar agle enzyme ka substrate banti hai. Jab end product (hara chokor) zyada ho jata hai to woh wapas jaa kar pehle enzyme se uski doosri jagah jurta hai (non-competitive inhibitor ki tarah). Enzyme 1 ruk jata hai, poora raasta band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahin banta. Misal: zaroorat se zyada ATP, ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek laboratory ruke hue enzyme mein zyada substrate dalti hai. Kin sooraton mein raftar bahal hogi, aur cyanide ki zehar-khurani is tarah kyun theek nahin hoti?
blocks.explanation: Raftar tab bahal hoti hai jab inhibitor competitive aur reversible ho, kyunke izafi substrate binding site ke liye use haraa deta hai aur kamzor bonds use hatne dete hain (succinate dehydrogenase par malonate). Cyanide cytochrome oxidase ke copper aur lohe se irreversible taur par aise bonds se jurta hai jo dilution, dialysis ya zyada substrate se nahin toot-te, is liye respiration ruki rehti hai.

items: Inhibitor enzyme ko product bane baghair rok deta hai; inhibitors dawaein (aspirin, antibiotics, anticoagulants) aur zehar (cyanide) hain.
Competitive inhibitors substrate jaise hote hain aur binding site ke liye muqabla karte hain (malonic acid); non-competitive inhibitors kahin aur jur kar active site bigarte hain (succinyl-CoA, ATP).
Reversible inhibitors kamzor bond banate hain aur zyada substrate se hat jate hain (malonate); irreversible inhibitors covalent bond banate hain (penicillin, cyanide).
Feedback inhibition: raste ki aakhri paidawar pehle enzyme ko rokti hai, jaise ATP apni tayyari rokta hai; inhibition raston ko qaboo karti hai aur dawaon, zehar aur research ki bunyad hai.
